in_arabic.name: يوسفة

in_urdu.name: یوسفہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: یوسفہ یوسف سے لیا گیا ہے، یہ ایک عرب نام ہے جو قدیم زمانے سے ہے، اس کا تذکرہ قرآن میں ہے، اور یہ خूबصورتی، کمال، اور حیا کے معنی رکھتا ہے

in_pashto.name: یوسفہ
in_pashto.long_meaning: یوسفہ د يوسف څخه اخيستل شوی، دا د عربي نوم دی چې په پخوا وخت کی څخه دی، دا په قرآن کریم کې یاد شوی، او دا ښکلا، کمال، او حیا معنی لري

data.cultural_impact: The name Yusufah holds great significance in Islamic and Middle Eastern cultures as it is the name of one of the most beloved and respected Prophets in Islam. Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) is known for his righteousness, the trials and tribulations he endured, and his eventual reunitation with his family, which make for compelling stories that resonate with many Muslims worldwide. The name Yusufah may evoke feelings of strength, perseverance, and purity within the culture, inspiring women to uphold these values.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Yusufah is a reminder of the wisdom and resilience of Prophet Yusuf as described in the Quran. It is believed that Allah (God) tested Prophet Yusuf in various ways, including being sold into slavery, being falsely accused of a crime, and spending years in prison, yet he remained steadfast in his faith and loyalty to Allah. The name Yusufah can serve as an inspiration for individuals to face their challenges with a strong spirit and unwavering faith, relying on the guidance and mercy of Allah. Additionally, the name holds spiritual significance as it embodies the name of an Islamic prophet, furthering a connection to the rich faith and tradition.

modern_usage.modern_context: Yusufah is a variant of the name Yusuf, which is of Arabic origin and means 'given to Joseph'. It is a central character in the Quran and the Hadiths, and is therefore used as a name in the Islamic community. In modern times, Yusufah has become a popular baby name, and can be found on various social media platforms and baby name websites.
